title: fix(runtime)!: the confirmation an action declares travels with the flow it starts
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authorable key moves; skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md already teaches that an action declaring `ai.requiresConfirmation` is refused to an AI service account's own key whatever it sends and is a person's to run, and this change holds the flow such an action starts to that same rule.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 服务账号(自身为主体、无 onBehalfOf 的 agent)按名启动一个流程时,若有 `type: 'flow'` 且 `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` 的动作指向该流程,两个 trigger 路由统一回动作入口自己的 `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`,在任何 run 产生之前拒绝,请求带不带 `confirm` 都一样。
- 为什么改:动作声明的确认要求应随它启动的流程一起走;账号不能替自己确认,所以按名启动与经动作启动必须是同一个答案。
- 风险与回滚:只影响 AI 服务账号经 trigger 路由启动这类流程;人、OAuth 委托 agent、系统主体、没有被门控动作指向的流程、动作入口自身的门都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts`(规则 2b:`confirmationGatedStarterOf` 与 `flowStartRefusal` 里新增的判断)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`(`servedActionDeclarations` 与读取失败的 503 分支)、`packages/runtime/src/flow-start-confirmation-gated-target.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/flow-start-confirmation-gated-target.test.ts`,预期 23 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: **the confirmation an action declares travels with what it starts.** An AI service account (`principalKind: 'agent'`, no `onBehalfOf`) does not confirm an action for itself. When an action of `type: 'flow'` whose `target` is a flow declares `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`, every door that starts that flow by name and states the environment's action declarations refuses the account with the action door's own refusal, `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` (its `details` naming the action, its object and the confirmation member), before any run exists, whatever the request carries. No new error code.

- `packages/runtime/src/flow-start-admission.ts`: rule 2b in the one flow start admission predicate `flowStartRefusal`, after the elevated-flow account rule and before the flow's own `requiredPermissions`. `FlowStartDoor` gains `actionDeclarations`, read only when the caller is an AI service account. `confirmationGatedStarterOf` reads the declared flag alone (`=== true`), over every holder of a declaration; `confirmationGatedStartRefusal` builds the refusal, its code and status typed to the action door's `ActionConfirmationRefusal` (a type-only import, so the module keeps no value edge into `action-execution.ts`).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`: both trigger routes (`POST /automation/:name/trigger`, legacy `POST /automation/trigger/:name`, one shared mapper) state the declarations, read as the `/actions` door reads them (the protocol's merged object and action listings, else the metadata service's), and serve the refusal's `details`. A declaration read that fails answers `503` and nothing runs.
- `packages/runtime/src/endpoint-policy.auth-gate.pin.test.ts`: pins that a declared `type: 'flow'` endpoint on its default `authRequired` refuses an API key `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` before its flow runs.

Unchanged: a person, an OAuth-delegated agent and the system principal (the declarations are not read for them); an account starting a flow no confirmation-gated action targets; the action door's own gate (`/actions`, MCP `run_action`), which states no declarations to the predicate and keeps answering its own 428.

Overlap: open draft #33646 edits `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` in other hunks (the address-registry imports and the bare-name admission, around lines 20, 1255, 1280 and 3861); no hunk of this PR touches those regions.

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/flow-start-confirmation-gated-target.test.ts` (23 cases), named by the rule:

- both trigger routes refuse the account 428, without `confirm`, with `confirm: true`, and with `confirm: true` beside `params`; the gated action counts embedded on an object, as a standalone item, and in the protocol's merged listing; a failed declaration read answers 503 and nothing runs;
- CONTROLS: a person starts the flow (and the declarations are not read); a delegated agent starts it; a flow no gated action targets is started by the account; a gated action targeting another flow gates nothing; the action door still answers its 428 to the account, with and without `confirm`;
- `confirmationGatedStarterOf`: the declared flag alone, each fact changed in turn gating nothing, and a deterministic pick among several.

Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first): replacing rule 2b's `return` turned 10 rule cases red and left the 13 others green (the 503 cases do not go through that `return`); restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- A declared `type: 'flow'` endpoint states no declarations either; the pin above holds its default `authRequired` refusal of an API key.
